title: LearnEasy
summary: Peer learning platform with genuinely different permissions for students, facilitators and administrators.
problem: Collaborative learning tools tend to assume one kind of user. Students, facilitators and administrators need genuinely different permissions over the same data.
approach: Role-based access control designed in from the start, a service-layer backend with caching, and real-time interaction over sockets. Containerised so it deploys the same everywhere.
highlights: Full-stack MERN platform with RBAC across three user types.
Service-layer backend with MongoDB and Redis caching.
CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployment on Docker and Kubernetes.
Secure coding throughout: bcrypt, TLS, CSRF and XSS protection.
